title: Finance Assistant
description:
An exciting opportunity has arisen for an experienced Finance Assistant to join the finance team of a large and highly successful business at their Head Office in Plymouth. This role will see you take responsibility for several cost centres - ensuring all expenditure is accurately recorded and reported in a timely manner.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with strong organisational skills, great attention to detail, and a passion for financial accuracy to join a well-established organisation with a supportive and collaborative working culture.

Key Responsibilities
- Take ownership of a selection of cost centres and balance sheet codes
- Post and evidence monthly accruals, prepayments and other journals as required
- Analyse costs versus budgets and communicate key variances to the Finance Manager team
- Process company expenses and credit card expenditure
- Code expenditure invoices via the data capture system, ensuring payment deadlines are met
- Conduct aged creditor reviews and supplier statement reconciliations
- Support budgeting and reforecasting activities
- Play a key role in meeting month-end and year-end deadlines
- Undertake ad-hoc finance tasks as required

Skills & Requirements
- Financial qualification (AAT or equivalent) preferred
- Previous experience within a similar finance or accounts role
- Excellent communication and analytical skills
- Strong organisational abilities and attention to detail
- Confident IT user with intermediate to advanced Excel skills
- Ability to work 5 days a week in office

Benefits
- Pension scheme
- Long service awards
- Employee discount
- Cycle to work scheme

If you're a motivated finance professional looking for your next step within a thriving business, we'd love to hear from you.

Please apply or contact Matt Jones on for more info.

Butler Rose is committed to equality in the workplace and is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Payroll Executive
description:
Role: Payroll Executive

Location: Plymouth

Salary: £, dependent on experience.

Hours: Full-time, 37.5 hours per week.

Contract Type: Permanent

Are you an experienced payroll professional looking to expand your skill set in a dynamic and supportive environment? Butler Rose is recruiting for a Payroll Executive to join a thriving organisation in Plymouth.

The Role
As a Payroll Executive, you'll play a crucial role in ensuring the smooth operation of payroll processes for three group companies, while also contributing to essential financial and administrative tasks. This is an excellent opportunity to enhance your career in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities
- Managing end-to-end payroll processes, ensuring accuracy and compliance.
- Submitting Real Time Information (RTI) to HMRC.
- Processing pension contributions and maintaining auto-enrolment compliance.
- Resolving payroll queries with professionalism and discretion.
- Supporting financial activities, including invoicing, reconciliations, and month-end processes.
- Contributing to the enhancement of internal controls and systems.

Skills and Experience
Essential
- Proven experience in running end-to-end payroll.
- Proficiency in Sage 50 Payroll or similar software.
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
- Advanced Excel skills.

Desirable
- A recognised payroll qualification (e.g. CIPP).
- Experience managing payroll for multiple entities.
- Familiarity with financial systems and journal posting.

What We're Looking For
A diligent, dependable professional who thrives in a team-oriented environment and demonstrates a proactive approach to problem-solving. Exceptional communication skills and a commitment to continuous improvement are a must.

This role is ideal for individuals passionate about payroll and finance, looking to make an impact in a growing organisation.

How to Apply
If you meet the criteria and are ready to take the next step in your career, Butler Rose wants to hear from you. Submit your CV or get in touch today.

title: Administrator
description: At Sentinel Healthcare, delivering excellent patient care is at the heart of everything we do. We are looking for an experienced and enthusiastic Administrator to join our friendly and supportive team, providing high-quality administrative and reception support across our clinical services. This varied and rewarding role involves supporting patients, clinicians and colleagues to ensure services run smoothly and efficiently. You will often be the first point of contact for patients, so a professional, compassionate and customer-focused approach is essential. The successful candidate will be organised, adaptable and able to manage multiple tasks in a busy environment. Excellent communication, attention to detail and strong IT skills are essential, along with the ability to work accurately and build positive relationships with patients, colleagues and partner organisations. We are looking for a supportive team player who is willing to work flexibly and contribute to a positive working environment. Previous experience in healthcare administration, particularly within primary or secondary care, would be advantageous. By joining Sentinel Healthcare, you will become part of a close-knit team that genuinely cares about making a difference to patients and the communities we serve. If you are looking for a rewarding role where your contribution is valued and every day brings something different, we would love to hear from you. Process electronic inbound referrals from GP's and other healthcare organisations using patient record systems. Booking and managing of patient appointments. Deal with routine patient enquiries. Ensure that electronic tasks are completed in a timely manner. Assist in monitoring generic email accounts. Send text reminder messages/emails to patients. Supporting Senior Administrative colleagues. Attending administrative and clinical meetings as required, which may occasionally be outside of core working hours. General office duties, such as post, scanning etc. Use the e-Referrals system (eRS) and the Electronic Patient Record systems (EMIS & SystmOne) to access inbound referrals and associated clinical documents booked in the Sentinel Healthcare clinical services. Liaise with local Referral Management Centres, GP surgeries and other external organisations as necessary. Using own judgement bring any GP referrals which may be inappropriate to the Clinician(s) attention. Ensure that inbound referrals are appropriately actioned i.e. accepted or rejected. Assist in co-ordinating the utilisation of booking slots across service areas, ensuring that capacity is fully utilised. Any under-utilisation to be reported promptly to the Operations Manager, so that appropriate action can be taken in advance. Re-book and cancel appointments as necessary in the patient record system and ERS. Any cancellations are to be undertaken following the set criteria for the service. Attention should be given to waiting time. Patients must be rebooked within specified time scales. Any problems meeting these criteria, including late cancellations, should be highlighted immediately to the Administration Manager. Ensure that relevant reminders (either by SMS, email or letter, where appropriate) have been sent to patients informing them of appointments. Ensure investigation requests are processed appropriately and results shown to the referring clinician. Assist in completing clinical coding and outcomes. Assist in using the patient record system to ensure that clinical reports and templates are re-produced and sent to GPs (and patients if required) following consultations. Open and prioritise correspondence, ensuring urgent correspondence receives prompt attention. Scan reports and other correspondence into the patient record system in a timely manner. Work closely with service area colleagues/clinicians to ensure good communication and that tasks are appropriately allocated and completed in a timely manner. Adherence to Sentinel Referral to Treatment Rulebook, Referral to Treatment Access Policy and to National Referral to Treat (RTT) waiting times rules and assist in making sure those targets are met. Assist in ensuring that Inter-Provider Transfer Forms (IPT) are completed and sent, as soon as the clinician requests onward referral to Secondary Care, in line with Waiting List Policy (48 working hours). Use other local hospital systems as necessary e.g, EPIC. Ensure that generic service nhs.net email accounts are monitored daily and appropriate action taken in a timely manner. Liaise with GP(s) or their team(s) when removing patients from the waiting lists as per protocols Have a sympathetic and caring manner when dealing with patients, ensuring all queries are handled timely, efficiently and effectively. Deal with telephone queries from both internal and external agencies in a professional manner in accordance with GDPR and statutory policies and procedures. To deal with all enquiries and complaints promptly and sympathetically and inform Senior Management of any problems immediately. Record accurate patient messages and complete information using the patient record system in a timely manner. Request hospital patient case notes (where requested by clinicians) ensuring that relevant clinical documentation (e.g. referral letter, x-rays, other diagnostic results and other supporting information) is available to the clinical teams in the patient record system. Maintain patient case notes and other documentation in good order and arrange return appropriately and in a timely manner. Assist in arranging and attending MDT meetings (where necessary) and ensure that patient notes, investigations and radiology images are available. Work flexibly and collaboratively with colleagues and help to develop a positive, supportive culture. Be prepared to work at various locations to provide appropriate administrative support to clinical teams as required. Attend and contribute positively and creatively to Administration Meetings. Demonstrate a positive, can-do attitude in the workplace. Ensure that resources are used efficiently and help to identify cost savings. Attend and represent Sentinel at external meetings as required Maintain an efficient electronic filing system. Responsible for covering colleagues during periods of annual leave and sickness. Undertake work as directed by the Administration Manager. Adhere to Patient Confidentiality, Information Governance and GDPR policies at all times.
